events.label: Oct. 7 attack
events.description: Hamas-led attack on Israel, also known as Operation Al-Aqsa Flood; beginning of the war in Israel and Gaza.

events.label: ICJ order
events.description: The International Court of Justice ordered Israel to take measures to prevent genocide in Gaza, including preventing and punishing direct and public incitement to genocide.

events.label: Rafah offensive
events.description: Israel began its Rafah offensive and moved to capture the Palestinian side of the Rafah crossing, a main entry point for humanitarian aid into Gaza.

events.label: ICJ settlements
events.description: The International Court of Justice said Israel's occupation of Palestinian territories is illegal and called for an end to settlement activity and annexation.

events.label: Occupation plan
events.description: The Guardian reported on the announcement of Israel's plan to expand military operations in Gaza and establish a sustained presence.
